shots.camText: The admirals · 35 mm · frontal and symmetrical, Serath centred one step ahead of the rank, empty white above her · a slow push in, 1 m
shots.line: Cut from the gallery's answer to the people who gave it: Grand Admiral Serath, centred, the gold collar at her throat; the rank of admirals behind her; ten thousand behind them. Nobody moves.
shots.note: Villeneuve: a designed symmetrical frame, one figure isolated in white on white, a slow push. The girl with her basket is planted small in the background, right.

shots.camText: The basket · 40 mm · side on from the aisle, Serath in profile facing right · the camera tracks 0.8 m right with the basket
shots.line: The girl walks past Serath's right side; at 1.4 s her toe catches her hem and she pitches forward. The basket leaves her hands with her walking speed: one low, slow arc, no higher than her own head, upright. She lands softly on hands and knees at 2.5 s. At 3.0 s the basket drifts past Serath's side at the height of her hanging hand; the hand moves a hand's width, closes on the handle, gives a little. Only the arm moves. The girl sits back on her knees; Serath lowers the basket to her; she takes it by 5.0 s.
shots.note: v3, after Q02A t1: real mechanics at Orison's slow fall. A cause (the hem), a ballistic arc, a catch that costs her nothing, follow-through in the wrist, a reaction after it. In profile, 'without looking' cannot be missed.

shots.camText: Unread · 35 mm · low, from the front, looking up past the warrant to her face · locked off
shots.line: The aide brings the warrant up into the bottom of the frame, red wax on it. Her hand goes out over it. Her face, above, never tilts: her eyes are on the tower.
shots.note: The premise of the film in one frame: the page and the eyes, apart. Villeneuve: low angle, the foreground object large, the face beyond it.

shots.camText: The seal · 85 mm · close on the hands only, no face in frame · locked off
shots.line: Her gloved hand comes down; the ring goes into the soft wax at 0.8 s and lifts away clean at 1.8 s. The mark is left in the wax on the page: an anchor in a ring of stars. Hold.
shots.note: The hand thread, gloved: it seals. No eyes in frame, so nothing can read (lesson 13). The wax stays on the page (lesson 14). The last second is a tail for the edit.
